title: 美联储官员哈马克：倾向小幅频繁调整利率
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: With the dual mandate as the destination, I see my reaction function as trimming the sales and minding the tiller to respond to changing conditions for the destination.
segments.zh: 以双重使命为终点，我的反应机制是微调航向，根据情况变化调整方向。

segments.en: When feasible, I generally think it's preferable to make smaller adjustments and to do so relatively quickly rather than to wait and risk needing a larger course correction. So let me walk you through
segments.zh: 在可行时，我认为小幅调整并快速行动，比等待并可能需大幅修正更可取。让我带您了解

segments.en: my reaction function and the variables I incorporate in making my monetary policy decisions.
segments.zh: 我的反应机制及制定货币政策决策时纳入的变量。

segments.en: Specifically, my function relies on economic data, financial conditions, forecasts, risks,
segments.zh: 具体而言，我的机制依赖经济数据、金融状况、预测、风险，

segments.en: and what I hear directly from people living in this economy. The gold standard hard economic data are indispensable. They can also take time to produce. I consult a wide variety of official data
segments.zh: 以及我从经济中人们直接听到的信息。硬经济数据不可或缺，但产出需时。我参考各种官方数据

segments.en: releases along with other indicators from the private industry where the economy is today.
segments.zh: 发布以及私营行业其他指标，了解经济现状。
